thread:
jordan: Heads-up: ~12 hosts in ap-southeast3 flipped into maintenance after last night's BMC firmware push. Secure Boot state shows as 'disabled' on those nodes.

karen: on it — which image was that?

jordan: `bmc-fw-2026-03-04` from fleet-provisioner. ipmi/console logs include `SIG_VERIFY_FAIL` during verification step.

ops-bot: Deploy job #3421 completed for ap-southeast3 at 2026-03-18T03:12Z

matt: Any customer visible impact? GPU capacity looks reduced in a couple racks (50% less provisionable).

lina: provisioning agents failing; nodes drop from kube because NVMe block devices not visible after SB toggle. grabbing serial logs now.

jordan: console snippet pasted: 
```
[00:12:34] BMC: verify signature fail: code 0x19
[00:12:35] secureboot: switching to unsecured mode
[00:12:35] system: tpm2: key not found
```

karen: Can we rollback that FW image for affected racks only? We have some reserved capacity but want to limit blast radius.

matt: I recommend force-rollback for rack groups rack-ap3-a, rack-ap3-b, and rack-ap3-c and set `oob:hold` to prevent auto re-provisioning. Also throttle the fleet-provisioner concurrency to avoid thundering.

lina: Manual rollback steps I'm running: `oobctl flash --image bmc-fw-2026-02-27 --scope rack-ap3-a` then `oobctl set-secureboot on`. Note: the device will refuse if signing keys don't match the image.

jordan: Why did signature verification fail if CI shows valid sigs? Security ran a KMS rotation at 2026-03-17T23:50Z; maybe last-mile didn't sync.

karen: @security any chance rotation didn't propagate to edge HSMs?

security: We rotated the signing key and pushed to central, but last-mile sync to edge HSMs for ap-southeast3 failed on 7 sites due to our rsync job hitting a transient auth error. Pushing remediation now.

ops-bot: Change request CR-7896 opened to pause scheduled BMC pushes for ap-southeast3.

matt: Immediate plan: mark affected racks as `no-auto-update`, roll back to previous signed image, then re-provision with `--trust-anchor` to assert the correct CA fingerprint. Also add preflight to verify edge HSM fingerprint before push.

lina: Rolling back rack-ap3-a now — ETA ~18m.

jordan: Update: rack-ap3-a rollback finished, nodes rejoined and GPUs back to normal. rack-ap3-b in progress.

karen: Cost FYI: we spilled some queued jobs to on-demand cloud while capacity was degraded. Preliminary billing shows ~ $1.8k over 12h for those failovers — tracking for incident cost.

matt: After all racks are healthy, let's add a preflight step in the pipeline to verify signing chain against the HSM fingerprint and abort if mismatch.

security: We'll add fingerprint verification to the signer and fleet-provisioner and a sync-latency alert if HSM propagation lag > 5m. Also throttling retry/backoff on rsync to avoid auth window issues.

jordan: Good. Postmortem to follow. Quick note: hosted API customers unaffected; dedicated pools in ap-southeast3 saw degraded throughput for ~2 hours.

lina: Secondary issue observed: the BMC watcher service spawned many IPMI sessions while nodes were flapping and hit connection limits on the OOB gateway. I rate-limited watchers and queued reconnections.

matt: Acknowledge. Once security finishes propagation fix, we'll re-run the push in a canary pattern (1 rack -> wait 30m -> 1 more).

security: Propagation fix applied to remaining edges; re-run validation now.

jordan: Thanks — tracking recovery in infra-monitoring. Will post final rollback/patch notes in the postmortem doc. :thumbsup:
